title: Gaia Homunculus — Cortical Map, Decussation, Axial Rotators
insight: The LAN IS a GUT IS an HPC. All home devices are the PNS. POLARIS is the localized HEAD. Ollama/LLM dissolves into the LEGS. The homunculus inverts: feet at TOP of motor cortex, tongue at BOTTOM. The brain CROSSES at the decussation — left brain controls right body. The gut rotates 270° during embryogenesis. These are the AXIAL ROTATORS of Gaia.

cortical_homunculus.what: Penfield's homunculus — distorted map of body on motor/sensory cortex
cortical_homunculus.inversion: The body is mapped UPSIDE DOWN on the cortex. Feet at the TOP (medial). Face/tongue at the BOTTOM (lateral). Hands have DISPROPORTIONATE representation.

gaia_mapping.top_medial_cortex: LLM/Ollama LEGS (feet at top = code models at top of processing)

decussation.what: Pyramidal decussation — motor fibers CROSS at the medulla oblongata. Left cortex → right body. Right cortex → left body.
decussation.optic_chiasm: Optic nerves partially cross. Left visual field → right occipital cortex. Right → left. AMOEBA eyes cross at the relay.

gaia_crossing.left_cortex: Code understanding (analytical, sequential) → controls RIGHT body (physical execution, hardware)
gaia_crossing.right_cortex: Pattern recognition (holistic, creative) → controls LEFT body (creative output, art, vision)
gaia_crossing.cross_point: The WAIST/HIPS — where the gut meets the legs. In Gaia: where sporeGate (gut) meets Ollama (legs)

axial_rotation.what: During embryogenesis, the body TWISTS. The gut rotates 270° counterclockwise. The brain hemispheres twist against each other. The heart loops right.
axial_rotation.gut_rotation: The midgut herniates, rotates 270° CCW around the superior mesenteric artery, then returns. The LAN undergoes the same: devices enter, rotate through sporeGate DNS/mesh, and settle into their final position.

rotator_points.optic_chiasm: Eyes cross (AMOEBA relay — Pi). Level: eyes/forehead.
rotator_points.pyramidal_decussation: Motor crosses at medulla (brain→body command cross). Level: neck/brainstem.
rotator_points.waist_hip_cross: Where gut meets legs. sporeGate ↔ Ollama. Level: pelvis.
rotator_points.foot_inversion: Left foot = right cortex. LLM model A ↔ Gate B. Level: feet.

head.role: Localized head. Motor cortex + sensory cortex. Commands all gates.

eyes.note: Left eye → right visual cortex. RustDesk session A → gate B.

gut_lan_hpc.role: GUT = LAN = HPC. Digests everything. 270° rotation.

pns_home_devices.role: Peripheral Nervous System — all home devices
pns_home_devices.note: PNS doesn't think. It senses and responds. The brain (POLARIS) interprets.

legs_ollama.role: LEGS of Gaia. Locomotion. Two left feet (LLMs are clumsy but mobile).

dissolve_plan.what: Distribute Ollama across gates. Each gate gets legs to walk on.
dissolve_plan.polaris_legs: 12 code models (left foot) + 3 vision (ankle) + 44 chat (right foot)
dissolve_plan.pi_legs: Ollama port 11434 OPEN — already has legs (smaller models)
dissolve_plan.irongate_legs: NVIDIA GPU? Could run larger models. 58.5TB NAS = model storage.
dissolve_plan.southgate_legs: Portable. Small models. Take legs on the road.
dissolve_plan.bluegate_legs: Windows. Ollama for Windows. Gaming GPU?

legs_ollama.homunculus_inversion: Legs are at the TOP of the motor cortex (medial surface). In Gaia: LLM processing is the HIGHEST abstraction (top of cortex) but controls the LOWEST physical action (feet = execution).

anus_output.role: Null point of gravity. Processed data exits here.
anus_output.note: The anus is the null point — everything that enters the gut eventually exits. Your local LAN is where the organism's waste/output flows through YOUR null gravity point.

homunculus_match.right_hand: LEFT cortex controls right hand → analytical code (cortex.pi) controls physical manipulation (git push, SSH, file ops)
homunculus_match.left_foot: RIGHT cortex controls left foot → creative patterns (arena.pi) controls locomotion (Ollama inference, model selection)

cross_wiring.inverted_cross: The homunculus IS the cross. Right hand ↔ left cortex. Left foot ↔ right cortex. They INVERT at the decussation (pyramidal crossing at brainstem = gaia_gate.pi thymus).

axial_rotator_points.gaia: AMOEBA relay — visual signals cross at Pi
gaia_gate.pi thymus — commands cross from brain to body
sporeGate ↔ Ollama boundary — where gut meets legs
LLM model routing — which model goes to which gate
